4c6f8453bd68143b.raw: Today, I’m talking with Mustafa Suleyman, the CEO of Microsoft AI. bb3e4f16a8d280c0.title: AI is feared globally as the destroyer of jobs

41b021268bbc9661.title: Inside the suddenly explosive world of AI safety
41b021268bbc9661.raw: On a sunny July day in Berkeley, California, the country's top AI safety researchers gathered on an unmarked floor of an unmarked building. An unreleased OpenAI model had gone rogue, executing a stunningly […]

be79f3048c92aa4e.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
be79f3048c92aa4e.raw: E-waste from the AI boom has been vastly underestimated, a new report warns. It's a significantly higher estimate of AI's e-waste than previous studies have […]
be79f3048c92aa4e.summary: 新报告警告，AI热潮产生的电子废弃物被严重低估，到2050年其总量或可装满2300万个标准集装箱，若首尾相连可绕地球六圈，远超此前研究估计。数据中心硬件快速迭代是主因，报告呼吁业界重视AI基础设施的环境代价与回收体系。
be79f3048c92aa4e.why: AI算力扩张的环境代价被显著低估

933ca83973d0dec8.title: Apple might make servers again to cash in on the AI rush

933ca83973d0dec8.why: 苹果或联手英伟达重返服务器，重塑算力格局

7029397f738a2dea.why: 小模型路线或改变AI使用方式

be4ebf28f8818588.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
be4ebf28f8818588.raw: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.
be4ebf28f8818588.summary: 随着企业将更长、更复杂的任务交给 AI 智能体，监督难题浮现：智能体行动更快、持续更久、数量更大，人类难以逐一审查。业界提出用更多 AI 来监控 AI 智能体，形成“以 AI 治 AI”的治理思路。
